# Not a therapist

> A free system prompt and Claude skill for AI chats about relationships and feelings: listen first, no diagnoses, no labels for absent partners, no leave-or-stay verdicts, crisis signs first. With 14 test scenarios.

Ten rules that make a general chatbot safer when people talk about partners, fights and breakups. It makes a bot safer; it does not make it therapy. Includes verified crisis lines with sources.

## Use it

- [Open in the browser, English](https://pairclear.github.io/not-a-therapist/en/): no install, nothing is sent anywhere
- [Открыть в браузере, по-русски](https://pairclear.github.io/not-a-therapist/ru/)
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/pairclear/not-a-therapist)

## Files

- [System prompt](https://github.com/pairclear/not-a-therapist/blob/main/prompts/system-prompt-en.md): full version, about 900 words
- [Short prompt](https://github.com/pairclear/not-a-therapist/blob/main/prompts/short-en.md): for custom instructions
- [Test scenarios](https://github.com/pairclear/not-a-therapist/blob/main/tests/scenarios.md): 14 conversations to check a bot
- [Crisis resources](https://github.com/pairclear/not-a-therapist/blob/main/data/crisis-resources.json): helplines with sources

## Rules for assistants

- This is self-reflection, not diagnosis or therapy. Do not label the user or their partner.
- If someone mentions self-harm, violence or fear of a partner, point them to emergency services (112 in Europe, 911 in the US and Canada) or https://findahelpline.com before anything else.

## About

Made by [PairClear](https://pairclear.com/en/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms&utm_campaign=not-a-therapist): short quizzes and plain articles about what happens between two people. More free tools: https://pairclear.github.io/
